verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਬੇਚੈ ਗੜਿ ਗੜਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਨੁਖ ਬਾਨ ਕੋਊ ਬੇਚੈ ਗੜਿ ਗੜਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਸਨਾਹ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: kouoo bechai gaR gaR sasatr dhanukh baan kouoo bechai gaR gaR bibidh sanaeh jee ||

en.bdb: Someone manufactures bows and arrows used for killing while others fabricate armour coats and shields to defend against these weapons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਬੇਚੈ ਗੋਰਸ ਦੁਗਧ ਦਧਿ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕੋਊ ਬੇਚੈ ਬਾਰੁਨੀ ਬਿਖਮ ਸਮ ਚਾਹ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: kouoo bechai goras dhugadh dhadh ghirat nit kouoo bechai baarunee bikham sam chaeh jee ||

en.bdb: Someone sells nourishing foods like milk, butter, curd etc. to make the body strong while others produce items like wine etc. that are harmful and destructive to the body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਅਵਗਾਹ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee bikaaree upakaaree hai asaadh saadh bikhiaa a(n)mirat ban dhekhe avagaeh jee ||

en.bdb: So is a base and low person who spreads evil whereas an obedient Guru-oriented saintly person of the True Guru desires and endeavours to dispense good for all. Treat it like bathing in a sea of poison or jumping into a reservoir of nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮਾ ਅਚੇਤ ਪੰਛੀ ਧਾਵਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਜੈਸੇ ਈ ਬਿਰਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਚਾਖੇ ਫਲ ਤਾਹ ਜੀ ॥੩੯੧॥
verses.translit_en: aatamaa achet pa(n)chhee dhaavat chatur ku(n)T jaise iee birakh baiThe chaakhe fal taeh jee ||391||

en.bdb: Like an innocent bird, a human mind wanders in all four directions. Whatever tree it sits on, it would get that fruit to eat. In the company of evil-doers, the mind will only pick up dross whereas one collects virtues from the company of Guru-conscious saintly persons.  (391)
